Name: Ore Detector
Author: AvalonMFX
Description:
This mod tracks the minable ores, ladders and holes in your current mine level. Additionally, it comes with configurable settings!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/K2wE19M.png[/img]

[list]
[*]displays [b]current [/b]and [b]maximum [/b]minable [b]ores [/b]in your current level
[*]predefined and [b]customisable [/b]position (Above player, top left corner, next to cursor, custom)
[*]optionally draws a line to all [b]holes [/b]and [b]ladders [/b]in your current level﻿ ([b]does not reveal[/b] the tile above the ladder)
[*][b]customisable [/b]colors for those lines
[*]toggle visibility
[*]a blacklist to select which ores should be displayed 
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4E3zYtL.png[/img]

[list]
[*]support for volcano on ginger island
[*]optionally draw a background behind the text to make it more readable in certain mine levels﻿
[*]more styles
[*]scaling
[/list]
[color=#6aa84f][size=5][b]Got any ideas or improvements to share?[/b][/size]
[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]Feel free to leave a comment or send me a message. I am always open for feedback :)
